text:
alyssa: hey team — need a POC workspace for ACME this week. They want: short-lived API keys for app devs, RBAC so only 2 engineers can call inference, and an option to test a Dedicated pool if load > 200 rps. timeline: kickoff Fri EOD. any blockers?

mike_se: noted. for RBAC we usually create a `poc_developer` role (invoke-only) + `poc_admin` for the AE/SE to manage invites. keep keys scoped and short-lived. can you confirm which endpoints they need (chat/generation vs embeddings)?

alyssa: they want chat/generation only initially (streaming ok). embeddings may come later. customer contacts: jordan_acme (eng lead) and priya (SRE) — will add emails in DM.

toni_provision: I can provision the workspace and API keys. flow I recommend: 1) create workspace `acme-poc-<region>` 2) create `poc_developer` role with scopes `inference:generate` and `stream:connect` 3) create API keys with 7d expiry and tag `poc/acme` 4) send invite links for team members.

toni_provision: quick example role snippet we use in infra:
```
role: poc_developer
permissions:
  - inference:generate
  - stream:connect
  - logs:read (optional)
expires: 7d
```

sam_security: couple security Qs from RnD security: do they need SSO/SCIM? Can keys be IP-restricted? KMS for private? Also would prefer not to allow embeddings initially. If they require private network, we need to discuss Private/VPC deployment — that's a separate timeline.

jordan_acme: FYI we cannot accept long-lived keys in our org. SSO is preferred but setting up SAML will take >2 weeks for us. Short-lived keys + IP allowlist is fine for the POC. Also we need KMS integration if we test Private later.

alyssa: ok good — short-lived scoped keys + IP allowlist. jordan — please DM priya's email so we can invite.

toni_provision: will set up workspace and create keys with IP allowlist. For Dedicated pool testing, submit the slot request form: https://redwood.ai/internal/dedicated-request — include expected qps and token/sec. If they cross 200 rps we'll spin a dedicated pool in the same region; that requires a 2-week lead time.

mike_se: pricing note — for POC we usually offer discounted reserved capacity for a short trial if they commit to a min monthly. alyssa, can you confirm if AE is pushing for a paid trial?

alyssa: AE wants to show cost delta; we'll request a 2-week dedicated trial with 20% off. I'll prepare a PO if provisioning is ready.

sam_security: one more: mark the workspace with policy `poc:data-no-retain` and disable analytics export — prevents logs leaving tenant. I'll file the security checklist entry.

prov-bot: workspace `acme-poc-us-west-2` created (temp-id: ws_6f3b). invite links generated, keys created with tags, expiry 7d.

toni_provision: sent invites to jordan_acme and priya. created two API keys scoped to inference:generate and stream:connect, IP allowlist set to customer CIDR. I left embeddings disabled.

jordan_acme: got invites + keys, testing now. thanks. will report latency numbers by EOD tomorrow.

alyssa: perfect — i'll coordinate PO and demo: plan to escalate to Dedicated trial if load testing looks good. thanks all :thumbsup:
